svg.text: A customer calls the business. If the call is not answered, the business
replies by SMS as a courtesy. By calling, the customer initiates contact and
consents to receive an SMS reply, booking confirmations and reminders.
Consent notice shown at point of contact & on the website:
"By calling us, you agree to receive SMS replies and booking messages.
Msg & data rates may apply. Reply STOP to opt out, HELP for help."
Hi, sorry we missed your call to {Business}. Reply with a good time and we'll
book you in, or book online: get.callpilotvoice.co.uk/book.html Reply STOP to opt out.
Opt-out: reply STOP · Help: reply HELP · hello@callpilotvoice.co.uk · get.callpilotvoice.co.uk
